lead: A new `TypeAtom` compiles the whole workspace green and lowers to `mixed`, silently.
body: `nvs_types::lower`'s atom match ends in `_ => env.interner.mixed()`, so the type parses, every declaration slot accepts it and every value in it is unchecked — a loosening no test asks about. Add the `nvs_types::ty::Ty` variant in the same slice; its exhaustive matches then name every arm to write.
